tool_args.rationale: The square-root-branch model failed fresh confirmation. The expanded mechanism notes identify a four-parameter cooperative Hill response with competitive sink inhibition and linear bleed as a plausible alternative for the observed monotone-concave u response and strong suppression at high s_grad. Fit all seven rows numerically and let the required fresh confirmation determine whether this revised stationary mechanism meets tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Seven existing rows already span a wide sink-gradient range and provide more observations than the four-parameter alternative requires; avoid additional measurement cost.
The attempted square-root-branch siphon model was decisively refuted on fresh confirmation (RMSE 3.35), so that branch structure is not retained.

All observations are at H=0.6 and the observed gradient-dependent suppression is better addressed by the authorized static sink-inhibition law; no temporal variation presently identifies a temporal model.
